CAPTURE GUIDANCE

Use QuizLens responsibly.

1

Start with consent

Screen and camera access use the browser's visible permission flow and stop when you end sharing.

2

Capture only new questions

QuizLens compares low-resolution frame fingerprints locally and waits for a stable change before saving.

3

Treat answers as claims

Only mark an answer verified after checking an independent, appropriate source. A Google search opens separately and does not change status.
